quality-series-olympiad-uniform-log-sine.centralDecision: Necessity uses positive blocks at x=1/N; sufficiency splits at the moving scale 1/x and applies a uniform Dirichlet estimate.

quality-series-olympiad-lacunary-Abel-gr.centralDecision: Count occupied exponential scales and bound both head deficit and tail independently of the moving cutoff.

quality-series-olympiad-quadratic-small-.centralDecision: The conjugate-root recurrence gives an exact exponentially small distance to an integer; the sine limit uses that identity.

quality-series-olympiad-alternating-infi.centralDecision: Pair factors to prove collapse at and below one half; above one half the quadratic logarithm remainder is summable.

quality-series-olympiad-Dirichlet-moment.centralDecision: Smallest nonzero index and dominated tail force the requested exponential support rate to lie on the reciprocal-integer lattice. The former coefficient-read-off question was rejected.

quality-series-olympiad-least-energy-seq.centralDecision: Two nonorthogonal moment vectors require a Gram inverse and a Pythagorean global optimality argument.

quality-series-olympiad-rooted-tree-weig.centralDecision: Lagrange inversion identifies coefficients; the small real branch is fixed by continuation from zero before Euler differentiation.

quality-series-olympiad-Poisson-partitio.centralDecision: Optimize an exponential moment majorant and match it with a single Stirling term at the moving dominant index. The fixed Bell-moment draft was rejected.

quality-series-olympiad-factorial-floor-.centralDecision: A strict factorial remainder resolves the floor; a nonnegative double-sum transformation then evaluates the generating series.

quality-series-olympiad-Riesz-product-en.centralDecision: Largest-frequency domination excludes every nontrivial zero Fourier combination before multiplying constant terms.

quality-series-olympiad-Euler-harmonic-w.centralDecision: Two Tonelli regroupings of the same positive double series give the Euler sum. Finite excluded prefixes do not add advanced normalized capacity.

quality-series-olympiad-Pade-cancellatio.centralDecision: An exact beta-integral remainder is evaluated at a moving argument. Its exponential rate requires an interior Laplace maximum and Stirling normalization.

quality-series-olympiad-factorial-asympt.centralDecision: Use a finite geometric remainder, normalize a Gamma density, prove concentration, then apply Stirling. No divergent infinite expansion is used.

quality-series-olympiad-Hilbert-kernel-s.centralDecision: Asymmetric row/column Schur weights give an upper bound; a harmonic sequence and middle logarithmic range prove sharpness.

quality-series-olympiad-Carleman-geometr.centralDecision: Polynomial weights change every mean. Weighted AM-GM, an exact tail telescope and logarithmic sharpness establish the best constant.

quality-series-olympiad-Dyson-alternatin.centralDecision: Good decrement recurrence with zero-exponent boundary values yields the factorial constant term; unequal-block Stirling gives the limit.

quality-series-olympiad-maximum-entropy-.centralDecision: Finite tail coarsenings establish entropy finiteness before Gibbs comparison; the geometric distribution attains the bound.

quality-series-olympiad-restricted-digit.centralDecision: A finite-state Fibonacci count combined with two-sided digit-block bounds proves the sharp convergence threshold, including divergence at equality.

quality-series-olympiad-conditional-doub.centralDecision: Identify a mixed discrete derivative; exact rectangular telescoping gives all three limits, while a wedge proves absolute divergence.

quality-series-olympiad-Hardy-mean-sharp.centralDecision: A tailored Holder weight and Bernoulli tail telescope give the operator bound; a finite power-law sequence proves sharpness.

quality-series-hard-Legendre-recurrence-.centralDecision: A standard ordinary generating-function differential equation fixes the analytic square-root branch. Correct useful content at Hard.

quality-series-hard-weighted-subset-q-pr.centralDecision: The inclusion recurrence yields a finite q-binomial product. Correct useful content at Hard.

quality-series-hard-binomial-convolution.centralDecision: A standard exponential generating-function product gives a separable Riccati equation and an interior evaluation before its first pole.

quality-series-olympiad-geometric-moment.centralDecision: Cauchy alternant factorization plus pairwise geometric exponent count; direct entrywise summation alone does not evaluate the determinant.

quality-series-olympiad-Abel-logarithmic.centralDecision: Finite Gamma products give even/odd partial sums; their Cesaro convergence and a second Abel summation prove the radial limit.

quality-series-hard-Liouville-Dirichlet-.centralDecision: Absolute convergence and unique factorization give a local Euler-factor ratio. Correct useful content at Hard.

quality-series-olympiad-finite-cycle-res.centralDecision: Prime cycle sizes13–41 remove the earlier routine small-angle cases. Multiplicity-aware Chebyshev logarithmic differentiation evaluates the resolvent.

quality-series-medium-ac-gaussian-trunca.centralDecision: Compute the consecutive omitted bounds at six and seven, then use monotonicity. Medium: theorem applicability and indexing are the challenge.

quality-series-medium-ac-erf-coefficient.centralDecision: Integrate the exponential Taylor series and identify its seventh-power coefficient; the radius follows from factorial growth. Medium.

q4-differential-equations-rotating-insta.centralDecision: A time-periodic symmetric field can be stabilized by rotation; recover the constant generator and its spectral growth, including the effect of a full return.

q4-differential-equations-weighted-strin.centralDecision: A change of independent variable alone leaves a first derivative; a dependent-variable gauge must remove it before boundary quantization and a lower-bound proof.

q4-differential-equations-homoclinic-mas.centralDecision: Use decay at both infinities to select the zero energy orbit, prove the positive profile and its unique turning amplitude, then integrate its fourth-power mass.

q4-differential-equations-critical-radia.centralDecision: The radial ODE is singular at the initial point; identify a globally positive bubble and justify uniqueness through the integrated radial equation before evaluating a global mass.

q4-differential-equations-isochronous-sh.centralDecision: An even shear of the coordinate changes the potential but cancels out of the period quadrature; show that the singular turning endpoints are integrable and the full orbit closes.

q4-differential-equations-polynomial-roo.centralDecision: Two polynomial coefficients and Newton sums give a standard Hard route.

q4-differential-equations-spectral-poten.centralDecision: Differentiate a boundary eigenvalue problem, eliminate the unknown eigenfunction derivative by Green identity, and normalize an oscillatory moment.

q4-differential-equations-logarithmic-un.centralDecision: Continuity with zero vector field at the initial point does not determine uniqueness; distinguish a double-logarithmic borderline by inverting the escape-time integral.

q4-differential-equations-oscillator-min.centralDecision: Represent two endpoint constraints as independent forcing moments, invert their nonorthogonal Gram matrix, and prove the resulting forcing is globally energy-minimizing.

q4-differential-equations-small-loop-geo.centralDecision: Four flows have zero net first-order time but a nonzero commutator; identify the second-order drift and control the accumulated remainder over many loops.

q4-differential-equations-boundary-layer.centralDecision: An explicit linear equation and a single exponential layer integral give a standard Hard route.

q4-differential-equations-logarithmic-re.centralDecision: Reciprocal separation and one logarithmic asymptotic give a standard Hard route.

q4-differential-equations-Green-kernel-s.centralDecision: Construct a Green kernel from matching and jump conditions, then relate its squared norm to a parameter derivative of its diagonal trace.

q4-differential-equations-inverse-period.centralDecision: Recover the turning-point coordinate from an entire energy-dependent period function; invert the Abel convolution and use evenness to rule out shear ambiguity.

q4-differential-equations-bistable-front.centralDecision: Two asymptotic equilibria select a unique wave speed; construct a monotone front and compare phase-plane graphs to exclude all other speeds.

q4-differential-equations-Robin-Lyapunov.centralDecision: The smallest total nonnegative potential supporting a boundary eigenfunction is the reciprocal of a Green-kernel maximum; the maximizing point moves from a boundary to the interior as the Robin parameter changes.

q4-multivariable-competing-parabolic-rid.centralDecision: Two terms separately attain sharp bounds, but their maximizing scales are incompatible; establish a product estimate before constructing paths.

q4-multivariable-positive-matrix-cone-in.centralDecision: Resolve a positive-definite matrix domain with a nonlinear triangular factorization, then combine its nonconstant Jacobian with Gaussian and gamma moments.

q4-multivariable-elliptic-torsion-sharp-.centralDecision: Find a Poisson witness adapted to an ellipse, use Green identity to turn a nonlinear-looking quotient into Cauchy-Schwarz, and prove equality is attainable.

q4-multivariable-support-function-area.centralDecision: Recover the actual boundary from a support function, check positive curvature, and use Green area rather than mistaking support distance for polar radius.

q4-multivariable-spherical-triangle-vect.centralDecision: A surface moment over a spherical triangle is recovered from its three great-circle arcs by vector Stokes, requiring edge orientations and angular lengths.

q4-multivariable-saddle-level-band.centralDecision: A thin band around an indefinite quadratic level has a logarithmic excess area; locate the crossing of its zero lines and prove the cutoff shape does not affect the leading coefficient.

q4-multivariable-cubic-coefficient-body.centralDecision: A region specified by polynomial roots becomes a coefficient-space volume only after handling the Vandermonde Jacobian and the six-to-one permutation symmetry.

q4-multivariable-Hessian-boundary-determ.centralDecision: The explicit polynomial permits direct Hessian expansion and disk moments. The arbitrary-boundary-data replacement removes this shortcut.

q4-multivariable-sphere-quadratic-homoge.centralDecision: Evaluate a nonseparable spherical integral by embedding it into a Gaussian volume integral and using the homogeneity of the radial variable.

q4-multivariable-projective-disk-integra.centralDecision: Recognize a projective Jacobian, prove the disk image is a bounded ellipse, and extract its area through square completion.

q4-multivariable-three-cylinder-moments.centralDecision: The cross-section changes from a clipped disk to an intact square; locate the transition and integrate the two regimes without treating the intersection as a sphere or two-cylinder solid.

q4-multivariable-confocal-distance-integ.centralDecision: Two distance constraints become independent coordinate bounds, while the product of focal distances cancels the elliptic-coordinate area density.

q4-multivariable-harmonic-gradient-extre.centralDecision: An interior derivative is an infinite weighted combination of boundary Fourier coefficients; obtain the exact sharp norm and construct the attaining harmonic function.

q4-multivariable-minimum-enclosing-ellip.centralDecision: Prove a minimum-area enclosing ellipse is centered and axis-aligned before solving a determinant maximization with a changing active constraint.

q4-multivariable-optimal-hyperbolic-doma.centralDecision: Optimize over measurable planar sets of fixed area; prove that a superlevel set is optimal, recover its hyperbolic boundary from the area constraint, and integrate the selected moment.

q4-multivariable-optimizer-fourth-envelo.centralDecision: Coupled implicit jets and the envelope derivative give a standard Hard route.

q4-multivariable-folded-map-counted-area.centralDecision: Use the area formula with preimage counts, identify the orientation-changing critical circle, and integrate the absolute Jacobian rather than the signed one.

q4-multivariable-Gaussian-entropy-variat.centralDecision: Identify a Gaussian that matches all prescribed moments, then use a pointwise convex inequality to prove it is the unique minimizer of a nonlinear integral over all densities.

q4-multivariable-Vandermonde-Gram-integr.centralDecision: Turn a coupled product of all pairwise differences into two determinants, integrate their permutation expansion, and evaluate a Cauchy moment determinant.

q4-multivariable-zonotope-volume.centralDecision: A many-to-one image of a five-dimensional cube fills a three-dimensional zonotope; ordinary rectangular Jacobians do not apply, so use the mixed determinant decomposition and its sign cases.

q4-differential-equations-Hermite-ODE-di.centralDecision: Recover a global product of every pairwise root separation through lowering operators and a resultant recursion, without solving any individual root.

q4-differential-equations-Mathieu-resona.centralDecision: Split the repeated unperturbed monodromy eigenvalue by a first-order interaction-frame integral, then convert spectral radius into exponential growth.

q4-differential-equations-inverse-ODE-co.centralDecision: Integrate a nonlinear analytic ODE into an inverse relation, extract its sparse Taylor coefficients, and match their exponential and algebraic asymptotic scales.

q4-multivariable-Hessian-from-boundary-d.centralDecision: Show that a nonlinear interior Hessian integral is determined entirely by prescribed boundary normal data, although the interior function is unspecified.

q4-multivariable-disk-Fekete-maximum.centralDecision: Turn the full pairwise distance product into a Vandermonde determinant, obtain a dimension-wide norm bound, and realize equality with a configuration of points.

q4-multivariable-disk-to-annulus-optimal.centralDecision: Prove the globally optimal coupling by angular alignment and a sharp scalar rearrangement bound, then evaluate the radial quantile cost.

q4-differential-equations-nonlinear-fast.centralDecision: Identify and control the fast deviation from the nullcline, prove its normalized tracking limit, and recover the slow algebraic decay.

q4-differential-equations-nonlinear-damp.centralDecision: Recover the unperturbed homoclinic orbit, evaluate its nonlinear dissipative work and Fourier forcing, and apply the simple-zero criterion for the explicitly defined first-order function.

q4-differential-equations-formal-Laurent.centralDecision: Find the resonant Laurent coefficient where the recursion loses its unknown; its compatibility condition selects the possible positive pole location.

q4-differential-equations-long-time-nonl.centralDecision: Pass to amplitude and phase, remove the mean-zero fast drift with a bounded periodic corrector, and justify a uniform slow-time limit before evaluating the envelope.

q4-multivariable-Gaussian-trigonometric-.centralDecision: Justify a random level-set length by a coarea band limit, control that limit geometrically, and integrate the independent anisotropic Gaussian gradient.

q4-differential-equations-Laguerre-zero-.centralDecision: Convert a polynomial ODE into an approximate algebraic equation for its zero resolvent; root positivity controls the derivative error and selects the correct branch.

q4-differential-equations-Riccati-turnin.centralDecision: Linearize the Riccati equation, select its recessive solution from the negative-time asymptotic, and match both small-argument Bessel powers to obtain a connection coefficient.

q4-differential-equations-global-Riccati.centralDecision: A polynomial comparison solution separates global trajectories from finite-time blowup; prove both directions with barriers rather than merely testing a candidate.

q4-differential-equations-minimum-peak-a.centralDecision: Two terminal constraints force a nontrivial switch in the extremal bounded acceleration; use a rearrangement inequality for a decreasing time kernel and solve the sharp feasibility equation.

q4-differential-equations-pantograph-ent.centralDecision: A dilation differential equation determines a strongly damped coefficient sequence; estimate the maximum term and the whole series to obtain a logarithmic growth order.

q4-multivariable-eccentric-annulus-capac.centralDecision: A doubly connected domain is given through two nonconcentric Apollonius circles; pull it back conformally, prove the sharp energy bound, and construct the attaining function.

q4-differential-equations-Bessel-zero-no.centralDecision: Normalize a singular-endpoint eigenfunction without integrating its square directly, using a differential identity and the root boundary condition.

q4-differential-equations-nonnormal-tran.centralDecision: Compute the Euclidean operator norm of the triangular flow, then maximize its logarithm over nonnegative time. The norm is e^(-t)(sqrt(K^2*t^2+4)+K*t)/2 and the unique positive critical time is sqrt(K^2-4)/K.

cn_56c06a644185a1bbccaa@1.centralDecision: The logarithmic map is an L2 isometry. Nonnegativity permits Tonelli before finiteness is known. Cauchy-Schwarz bounds every translation correlation and the exponentially decaying positive kernel has finite beta mass. Unit-norm long interval indicators have triangular correlations converging pointwise to1, with the kernel as an integrable majorant. Thus the exact bound is sharp. Equality forces translation defects to vanish for almost every nonzero shift; even one such shift makes a nonzero L2 function periodic, impossible. Strong continuity extends the stated argument to every shift. This is a complete sharpness/nonattainment proof, not just a formal candidate eigenfunction.

candidate.scope: Final independently reviewed task and effective-family option context.
